defect: stream drop qualification can resemble reversed ready/valid gating
rationale: When drop_i is asserted, the filter consumes the input by asserting ready_o and suppresses valid_o. Otherwise both handshake signals pass through unchanged.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the two-signal stream filter to its combinational handshake equations and renamed the module top.

mutation.description: Conditional ready and valid assignments intentionally move in opposite directions when a beat is dropped.
